verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming tool, and data portability is a fair question for that kind of product, for example exporting paired devices or settings. The pack documents no export feature or open export format. Having no account or server, open-source code, and readable logs are adjacent traits, not an export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
